label: prose:intro-phi-q-markov-schur-weyl-tower
html:
Summing the Markov trace across the infinite Schur–Weyl tower H_2(q) \subset H_3(q) \subset \cdots \subset H_\infty(q) requires a resummation operator that converts formal power series in the skein parameter h = q - q^{-1} into closed rational and polylogarithmic invariants. This section introduces the \varphi_q resummation functor and develops its three principal applications:

  1. Markov trace factorisation and resummation: The Markov property induces a multiplicative factorisation across connected sums and recursive braid ascents, enabling \varphi_q to resum the Vassiliev finite-type filtration into closed per-braid mass towers.
  2. The lepton mass tower and resurgent Stokes–DT bridge: Specialising the tower to the three-strand Bring-surface channels generates the charged-lepton mass hierarchy (e, \mu, \tau), where the one-loop prefactor exponent -1/2 follows from van der Veen's colored-Jones asymptotics and the closed-sector coefficient A_\omega(4_1) = 3 is conditionally identified with a Donaldson–Thomas BPS state count via the Garoufalidis–Gu–Mariño resurgent Stokes bridge.
  3. Schur–Weyl decomposition and mass positivity: Decomposing the graded Markov trace over Schur–Weyl tensor powers proves that the categorical mass functional is strictly positive on every non-trivial hyperbolic braid closure.
